orderedEvents.text: A golden HONEYCOMB hangs from a branch. KEEN has built a catapult from sticks and a bendy branch. He loads a BERRY. Steps back. One eye closed. Tongue out. He lines up the shot — aiming carefully at the honeycomb. Nearby — ZENNY sits cross-legged on a leaf. Zenny meditates. Keen fires. WHOOSH — the berry flies — SPLAT. Right onto Zenny’s forehead.
